text:
maria: Heads up — nightly e2e canary (canary-02) failed perf gate around 03:10 UTC. p95 latency jumped ~60% vs baseline and throughput dropped ~30% under staggered load profile.

akash: saw that alert. any quick logs/links?

maria: job -> buildkite.com/redwood/e2e/8523, artifact link: https://artifacts.redwood/e2e/canary-02/8523. There's a heatmap in the artifacts folder showing tail latency spikes aligned with KV cache churn.

jen: curious if this is the same pattern as last week's longseq bump or something new. sequence mix this run was: 70% short, 20% med, 10% long (4096).

samir: @maria can you paste the runner config? wondering if batching params changed.

maria: runner config excerpt:
```
staggered_load:
  ramp_up: 180s
  concurrency: 120
  seq_distribution: [0.7,0.2,0.1]
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 2048
  idle_ms: 8
```

kevin: hmm idle_ms bumped to 8 in the last infra PR (deploy-321). could increase latency for short tails if micro-batches get starved.

akash: can we do a quick rerun with idle_ms=4 and compare? small experiment.

maria: +1. I can kick it off if someone gives the greenlight. need a bisect or quick A/B?

jen: do quick A/B: rerun one canary with old idle_ms=4 and one with current 8, keep other params identical. label jobs A and B.

samir: i'll help monitor. also collect kvcache hit/miss and batching histogram. add env: DEBUG_KVCACHE=1.

maria: kicking off now. commands I used:
```
./scripts/e2e_run --profile canary-02 --labels A --set batching.idle_ms=4 --log-dir /tmp/e2e/A
./scripts/e2e_run --profile canary-02 --labels B --set batching.idle_ms=8 --log-dir /tmp/e2e/B
```

ci-bot: Triggered builds: A -> buildkite.com/redwood/e2e/8524, B -> buildkite.com/redwood/e2e/8525 :rocket:

kevin: nice, I'll tail the metrics. if A looks good we can revert deploy-321 or patch batching defaults.

jen: small note — also compare KV cache occupancy vs request window. last time eviction pressure caused fetch latency to spike.

samir: got it, watching kv_cache.misses and kvcache.evictions.

maria: builds running. ETA ~12m. tagging @oncall in case it becomes broader.

ops-bot: On-call (alex) notified for alert: e2e-canary-perf-fail, incident channel #incidents updated.

akash: if both A and B still fail we'll need deeper bisect across recent infra commits (deploy-317..deploy-321). i'll volunteer to spearhead if needed.

maria: results in. preliminary: A (idle_ms=4) p95 ~ baseline +5%, throughput stable. B (idle_ms=8) p95 +62%, throughput -28%. artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/e2e/A/8524 https://artifacts.redwood/e2e/B/8525

jen: that's pretty decisive. looks like the idle_ms change is the prime suspect.

kevin: can we roll a hotfix to revert batching idlem db to 4 for canary pool? small config change should be safe.

maria: opened deploy-roll/327 to revert default idle_ms. pinging infra for fast deploy.

samir: will follow up with a longer bisect plan to confirm no other regressions.

maria: thanks team. follow-up actions: 1) hotfix revert (deploy-roll/327) 2) run full overnight longseq matrix with old vs new settings 3) postmortem note in #postmortems if it affects prod.

kevin: :thumbsup: i'll keep monitoring metrics and update dashboard.

jen: nice work catching this quickly.

maria: closing thread when rollback verifies stable. :eyes:
